title: The Hidden Art
content: "The Hidden Art" is a new online publishing platform that focuses on the fields of illustration, concept art, and visual development for entertainment.The website has a gallery of selected artists, including some of my favorites, such asSimon Stalenhag,Ian McQue,Robh Ruppel,Eyvind Earle, andDice Tsutsumi—so I'm really thrilled that they chose to include my stuff, too.Based in Barcelona, they publish in English and Spanish, and they plan to produce daily articles about the inspiration and the stories behind concept art.The Hidden Art
